# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An overnight gap up that fails to attract follow‑up volume and stalls in the first 30 minutes often fades, providing a short opportunity. The edge exists because weak volume on up‑bars indicates lack of conviction, and price failing to make a new high suggests the gap will not continue.

## Mechanism

Entry: Identify an opening gap up >0.3% (today’s open > prior close ×1.003). Within the first 30 minutes, if price does not make a new high and the average volume on up‑bars is <0.7× the prior bar’s volume, then enter short on the first bar that closes below VWAP with a bearish close. Exit: stop at the high of the gap (prior day’s close); TP1 at gap fill (prior close); runner trailed by a 15% highest‑high trailing stop. Regime hints: VIX <22, time 09:30‑10:30, EMA ribbon slope |slope| <0.04%.
